mapper.select: select * from t_auth_refresh_token where token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update
mapper.update: update t_auth_refresh_token set status = 'REPLAYED', consumed_at = coalesce(consumed_at, #{now}) where token_id = #{tokenId} and status in ('ROTATED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED')
update t_auth_refresh_token set status = 'REVOKED', consumed_at = coalesce(consumed_at, #{now}) where session_id = #{sessionId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

update t_auth_refresh_token token join t_auth_refresh_session session on session.session_id = token.session_id set token.status = 'REVOKED', token.consumed_at = coalesce(token.consumed_at, #{now}) where session.user_id = #{userId} and token.status = 'ACTIVE'
